verdict.rationale: Factory documents redirecting live sessions in the Factory App, where inline diff comments and design-mode instructions are acted on in place. It runs across the web/desktop App, the terminal CLI and editor integrations, and its Sessions API lets you drive a session's lifecycle and messages. Nothing shows handing an in-progress agent task from one surface to another, such as resuming a cloud or Linear-delegated session in the local terminal or editor to finish it. missing for 10: documented session handoff/resume across editor, terminal and browser; taking over a remotely delegated in-progress task; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: inline code review comments on a diff line by line. Droid acts on the feedback in place.
